title: Lanes inside the harness sandbox
body:
Outcome: `npm run fast` passes inside the sandbox, and one real task is delivered by a sandboxed lane holding only the token of A5, with `strictAllowlist` on.
Why: the sandbox already closes credential files, the `gh` token, hooks and git config with no configuration (`04` (f)); what fails is `git add -A` on placeholder entries (`scripts/fast-check.ts:133-134`, `04` (f2)), and an environment variable with a token name passes through.
Proof: the checks of `spike-f.md` re-run green for ordinary work; the task's PR merges; the environment inside the lane holds no credential but the limited one.
Scope: `scripts/fast-check.ts`, `.gitignore`, a settings fragment for lanes.
Order: lane for the fix; operator for the default; the delivery run after A5.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice C1.

Fix shipped (PR for C1): treeKey stages via ls-files + update-index and changedFiles skips non-regular entries, so `npm run fast` no longer dies on the sandbox /dev/null placeholders (char devices, reproduced with bwrap --ro-bind /dev/null); opt-in fragment .claude/settings.sandbox.json (strictAllowlist, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 which forces default permission mode so it carries permissions.allow Bash). .gitignore needed no entries (sandbox leaves empty .env*, .npmrc, package-lock.json etc. untracked in the worktree: delete after a sandboxed run). Remains: the sandboxed delivery run holding only the App token, after the App task t-xyjfsjz.

Gaps after the fix (2026-11-10): in the sandbox `npm run fast` still fails on test/worker/acceptance-checks-containment.test.ts (ENOENT outside the clone; that test leaves with t-9w41zw0); token-named env scrubbing by CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB is not yet proven — the delivery run must print the lane environment's variable names.
